verdict: Strong ROAS this period, but purchase days are too clustered to call stable.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.86 for every $1 spent — a 57% jump week-over-week — on $1,498.48 in total spend. That efficiency number is real, but it comes with an asterisk: all 24 purchases landed on just 5 of the 28 days, and the last three days (Aug 14–16) produced zero purchases against roughly $52 in daily spend. Smoothing out that purchase cadence is the near-term focus, and new ad creative is being prepared to reduce reliance on a single campaign that currently carries the bulk of spend. Google Business Profile engagement dropped 28% week-over-week with two days reading zero, which appears to be a tracking gap; the 52 calls and 80 direction requests recorded this period confirm local demand remains present.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days — $3.86 back for every $1 spent
purchases driven by Meta ads this period, all on just 5 active days

watch_item.issue: Purchase volume is spikey — 18 of 28 days recorded zero sales, and the last three days continued that drought.
watch_item.fix: Fresh ad creative is being developed this week to broaden delivery beyond the single top campaign and build more consistent daily purchase flow.
